title: Finger–liquid friction
review_mode: read-only review of retained scientific/equation/evidence records; no fitting, acquisition or new literature search
review_scope: Original findings, first continuation when present, latest continuation and supplemental material-response tasks when present. Independent computational review is a separate artifact.
grouping_and_information_scope: Whole participants with shared fluid panel; trial-median coefficient of friction at trial-average speed/load, not prospective control.
portfolio_disposition: Scoped numerical references, tested hypotheses and preserved falsifications; no independently established new fundamental law or demonstrated deployment impact is admitted.
aggregate_score_reason: Scientific dimensions are distinct; task difficulty and validation scope are disclosed without converting them into invented precision or a composite discovery score.

finding_reviews.statement: An established Hersey/Stribeck response is the useful original reference; physiological additions do not establish a new rule.
finding_reviews.historical_evidence_status: Original historical reserve status is retained in source records; every outcome is exposed now. Continuation model selection uses development evidence but cannot restore fresh confirmation.

mechanism.rationale: Known lubrication branches are plausible; the pressure term is an observational conditional association and does not transfer fluid-independently.

novelty.rationale: The source already presents Stribeck collapse; refitting exponents repairs information fairness. No new universal friction law is supported. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.

significance.rationale: The measured endpoint and matched controls supply a useful reproducible local benchmark. Whole participants with shared fluid panel; trial-median coefficient of friction at trial-average speed/load, not prospective control.

reproducibility.rationale: Frozen equations/model states and numerical evidence are present and hash-bound here. This scientific document review is separate from independent computational replay; execution validity must be supplied by that review and the raw-preparation audit.

impact.rationale: Potential monitoring, calibration or experiment-planning value is bounded by the stated endpoint. No operational intervention, measured deployment savings, clinical effect or independent real-world benefit is demonstrated in this portfolio.
